description: History row hierarchy and intentional filter options (REQ-026; C53, G18; R08, R19; V07, V08; AC-C53-01, AC-R026-01; JOURNEY-026). On the real History route (/history, reached through the existing auth guard) every workout row of the shared HistoryList (src/ui/history-list.tsx) has its title alone on its own full-width row, its status then its stored date together on the row beneath, then its metrics (focus, requested minutes, actual minutes when recorded, intensity). The Show filter (src/state/history.ts HISTORY_FILTERS) offers All entries, Completed and Partial; Rest days and Not started are no longer options, but nothing is deleted: All entries still lists the derived rest runs and every never-started session with its stored Not started status, and the saved detail (/history/:id) reads the record's own day, status and actual minutes. Loading, empty, filtered-empty and error keep their meanings. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=screens (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) adds a History part drawing the route's own HistoryCollection over stored rows held in memory, reading and writing nothing. check-01 proves it in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic session that writes nothing; every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-026 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-026.spec.ts --project=mobile
